title: Test Case IR
description: Canonical, framework-agnostic representation of a single test case. Every input source (prompt, CSV, Gherkin, test-management tool) normalizes into this shape before any Playwright code is generated.

preconditions.description: State the app must be in before the steps run (often becomes a fixture or beforeEach).

steps.description: Ordered user actions in plain language. The generator maps each to a Page Object call.

testData.description: Key/value inputs referenced by the steps.

expected.description: Assertable expected results. The generator MUST emit at least one expect() per entry.

rawText.description: Original text block (PDF/prompt source) the LLM normalizes from; kept for traceability.

needsClarification.description: True when steps or expected results were ambiguous; the agent must ask the user before generating.

needsLlmNormalization.description: Set by the deterministic parser for free-text prompts that the LLM parser must finish normalizing.
